title: Enhanced Tracking Protection
description: Learn how Oasis's Enhanced Tracking Protection works to block trackers, protect your privacy, and give you control over your browsing experience.
content:
Enhanced Tracking Protection is a powerful privacy feature in Oasis that automatically blocks known trackers from following you across the web. This protection helps prevent companies from collecting your browsing data, building profiles about your online behavior, and targeting you with personalized ads. Understanding how this protection works and how to customize it helps you take control of your online privacy.

Pro Tip

Enhanced Tracking Protection is enabled by default in Oasis to protect your privacy. You can customize the protection level based on your needs, from standard protection to strict blocking of all known trackers.

What Is Enhanced Tracking Protection?

Enhanced Tracking Protection is a comprehensive privacy feature that blocks various types of trackers that attempt to monitor your online activity. These trackers can be found in ads, social media buttons, analytics scripts, and other web content that tries to build profiles of your browsing behavior.

Types of Trackers Blocked

Enhanced Tracking Protection blocks:

  • Social Media Trackers: Facebook, Twitter, and other social platforms
  • Cross-Site Trackers: Scripts that follow you across websites
  • Fingerprinting Trackers: Attempts to identify your device uniquely
  • Cryptomining Scripts: Unauthorized cryptocurrency mining
  • Analytics Trackers: Third-party analytics and measurement tools

Protection Benefits

How tracking protection helps you:

  • Privacy Protection: Prevents companies from building profiles about you
  • Faster Loading: Blocks unnecessary tracking scripts
  • Reduced Data Usage: Less data transferred to tracking servers
  • Better Performance: Improved page loading speeds
  • Control Over Data: You decide what information is shared

How Enhanced Tracking Protection Works

Automatic Detection

How Oasis identifies and blocks trackers:

  • Known Tracker Lists: Uses comprehensive lists of known tracking domains
  • Behavioral Analysis: Identifies tracking behavior patterns
  • Real-Time Blocking: Blocks trackers as they attempt to load
  • Smart Filtering: Distinguishes between essential and tracking content
  • Continuous Updates: Regularly updates tracker lists for maximum protection

Protection Levels

Different levels of tracking protection available:

  • Standard: Blocks known trackers in private windows
  • Strict: Blocks all known trackers on all sites
  • Custom: Allows you to choose specific protection options
  • Off: Disables tracking protection (not recommended)

Blocking Methods

How trackers are blocked:

  • Network Blocking: Prevents connections to tracking servers
  • Script Blocking: Blocks tracking JavaScript and other scripts
  • Cookie Blocking: Prevents tracking cookies from being set
  • Fingerprint Protection: Blocks fingerprinting attempts
  • Content Filtering: Filters out tracking-related content

Protection Levels Explained

Standard Protection

Default protection level in Oasis:

  • Private Windows: Blocks all known trackers
  • Regular Windows: Blocks social media trackers and cross-site trackers
  • Fingerprinting: Blocks fingerprinting attempts
  • Cryptomining: Blocks unauthorized mining scripts
  • Social Media: Blocks social media tracking buttons and scripts

Strict Protection

Maximum privacy protection:

  • All Trackers: Blocks all known trackers on all sites
  • Enhanced Fingerprinting: More aggressive fingerprinting protection
  • Cookie Blocking: Blocks all third-party cookies
  • Content Blocking: Blocks more types of tracking content
  • Cross-Site Protection: Enhanced protection against cross-site tracking

Custom Protection

Personalized protection settings:

  • Selective Blocking: Choose which types of trackers to block
  • Site Exceptions: Allow specific sites to bypass protection
  • Cookie Settings: Customize cookie blocking behavior
  • Fingerprinting Options: Choose fingerprinting protection level
  • Content Filtering: Select which content types to block

How to Access Tracking Protection Settings

Method 1: Through Settings Menu

Access tracking protection settings:

  1. Open Oasis Settings (Menu → Settings)
  2. Navigate to "Privacy & Security" section
  3. Find "Enhanced Tracking Protection"
  4. Click on the protection level to customize
  5. Choose your preferred protection level
  6. Save your preferences

Method 2: Address Bar

Quick access through address bar:

  1. Type about:preferences#privacy in the address bar
  2. Press Enter to go directly to privacy settings
  3. Scroll to "Enhanced Tracking Protection" section
  4. Select your preferred protection level
  5. Configure additional options as needed

Method 3: Shield Icon

Access through the shield icon:

  1. Look for the shield icon in the address bar
  2. Click on the shield icon to see protection status
  3. Click "Enhanced Tracking Protection" to access settings
  4. Choose your protection level
  5. Configure site-specific exceptions if needed

Customizing Tracking Protection

Protection Level Selection

Choose the right protection level for your needs:

  • Standard: Good balance of privacy and compatibility
  • Strict: Maximum privacy but may break some websites
  • Custom: Fine-tune protection to your preferences
  • Off: No protection (not recommended for privacy)

Site Exceptions

Managing site-specific exceptions:

  • Allow Specific Sites: Disable protection for trusted websites
  • Block Specific Sites: Enable strict protection for certain sites
  • Manage Exceptions: View and edit your exception list
  • Remove Exceptions: Remove sites from exception list
  • Import/Export: Share exception lists between devices

Advanced Settings

Advanced tracking protection options:

  • Cookie Settings: Configure third-party cookie blocking
  • Fingerprinting Protection: Choose fingerprinting blocking level
  • Content Blocking: Select which content types to block
  • Cross-Site Tracking: Configure cross-site tracking protection
  • Social Media Tracking: Control social media tracker blocking

Understanding Tracker Blocking

What Gets Blocked

Types of content that Enhanced Tracking Protection blocks:

  • Tracking Scripts: JavaScript that tracks user behavior
  • Analytics Tools: Third-party analytics and measurement
  • Social Media Buttons: Like, share, and follow buttons
  • Advertising Networks: Ad tracking and targeting scripts
  • Fingerprinting Scripts: Device identification attempts

What Doesn't Get Blocked

Content that typically remains functional:

  • Essential Site Functions: Core website functionality
  • First-Party Content: Content from the website you're visiting
  • Security Features: Security and authentication scripts
  • Payment Systems: Secure payment processing
  • Accessibility Features: Screen readers and accessibility tools
Privacy Note

Enhanced Tracking Protection is designed to block trackers while maintaining website functionality. If a website doesn't work properly, you can temporarily disable protection for that specific site.

Monitoring Protection Status

Shield Icon Indicator

Understanding the shield icon in the address bar:

  • Gray Shield: No trackers detected or protection is off
  • Purple Shield: Trackers were blocked on this page
  • Shield with Number: Number of trackers blocked
  • Shield with Warning: Some trackers couldn't be blocked
  • Shield with Check: All trackers successfully blocked

Protection Reports

Viewing detailed protection information:

  • Click Shield Icon: See what was blocked on current page
  • View Blocked Content: See specific trackers that were blocked
  • Protection Statistics: View overall protection statistics
  • Site-Specific Info: See protection status for specific sites
  • Settings Access: Quick access to protection settings

Privacy Reports

Comprehensive privacy reporting:

  • Weekly Reports: Regular privacy protection summaries
    • Tracker Statistics: Number and types of trackers blocked
  • Site Analysis: Which sites have the most trackers
  • Protection Trends: How protection has improved over time
  • Recommendations: Suggestions for better privacy protection

Troubleshooting Common Issues

Website Compatibility Issues

When websites don't work properly:

  • Identify the Problem: Check if tracking protection is causing issues
  • Temporary Disable: Temporarily disable protection for the site
  • Site Exception: Add the site to your exception list
  • Lower Protection Level: Try standard instead of strict protection
  • Report Issues: Report broken sites to Mozilla

Performance Issues

If protection affects performance:

  • Check Protection Level: Strict protection may impact performance
  • Update Oasis: Ensure you're using the latest version
  • Clear Cache: Clear browser cache and cookies
  • Disable Extensions: Check if other extensions conflict
  • Reset Settings: Reset protection to default settings

False Positives

When legitimate content is blocked:

  • Report False Positive: Report incorrectly blocked content
  • Site Exception: Add the site to your exception list
  • Custom Settings: Adjust protection settings for specific sites
  • Check Updates: Ensure tracker lists are up to date
  • Contact Support: Get help from Mozilla support

Best Practices for Enhanced Tracking Protection

Privacy Best Practices

Maximizing your privacy protection:

  • Use Strict Protection: Enable strict protection for maximum privacy
  • Regular Updates: Keep Oasis updated for latest protection
  • Review Exceptions: Regularly review and clean up site exceptions
  • Monitor Reports: Check privacy reports regularly
  • Combine with Extensions: Use additional privacy extensions

Compatibility Best Practices

Balancing privacy with functionality:

  • Start with Standard: Begin with standard protection level
  • Test Websites: Test important websites with strict protection
  • Use Exceptions Wisely: Only add exceptions for trusted sites
  • Monitor Performance: Watch for performance impacts
  • Report Issues: Help improve protection by reporting problems

Security Best Practices

Additional security considerations:

  • Keep Updated: Always use the latest version of Oasis
  • Use HTTPS: Ensure secure connections when possible
  • Strong Passwords: Use strong, unique passwords
  • Two-Factor Authentication: Enable 2FA where available
  • Regular Security Checks: Monitor for security issues

Frequently Asked Questions

General Questions

Common questions about Enhanced Tracking Protection:

  • Is it enabled by default? Yes, Enhanced Tracking Protection is enabled by default
  • Does it slow down browsing? No, it typically improves performance by blocking unnecessary scripts
  • Can I disable it completely? Yes, but it's not recommended for privacy
  • Does it block all ads? No, it only blocks tracking-related content
  • Is it available on mobile? Yes, Enhanced Tracking Protection works on mobile devices

Technical Questions

Technical aspects of tracking protection:

  • How does it identify trackers? Uses comprehensive lists of known tracking domains
  • Does it update automatically? Yes, tracker lists are updated regularly
  • Can I see what's blocked? Yes, click the shield icon to see blocked content
  • Does it work offline? No, it requires internet connection for updates
  • Can I customize blocking rules? Yes, through custom protection settings

Privacy Questions

Privacy-related concerns:

  • Is my data still collected? Protection reduces but doesn't eliminate all data collection
  • Does it work with VPNs? Yes, it works alongside VPN services
  • Can websites detect it? Some websites may detect protection but can't bypass it
  • Is it 100% effective? No protection is 100% effective, but it significantly improves privacy
  • Does it affect login sessions? No, it doesn't interfere with legitimate login functionality

Additional Resources

For more information about Enhanced Tracking Protection, we recommend:

Mozilla Enhanced Tracking Protection Guide - Official guide from Mozilla

Firefox Enhanced Tracking Protection - Detailed desktop guide

Mozilla Privacy Tips - Additional privacy protection tips

Important Disclaimer

This guide discusses Oasis Enhanced Tracking Protection, which is based on Mozilla's Firefox Enhanced Tracking Protection technology. The protection features and privacy practices described are specific to Oasis's implementation. Other browsers may have different tracking protection systems and privacy practices.

Note: Oasis has a version derived from Firefox core, which is why it shares similar tracking protection capabilities and can benefit from Mozilla's privacy-focused approach to blocking trackers.
